title: Walsh spectrum of the Dobbertin APN power function
summary: Prove the parity-dependent Walsh spectrum and nonlinearity formula conjectured for every Dobbertin APN power function.

formal_statement.body: For every positive integer $m$, put $n=5m$ and $$d=2^{4m}+2^{3m}+2^{2m}+2^m-1.$$ Determine whether the extended Walsh spectrum of $F(x)=x^d$ on $\mathbb F_{2^{5m}}$ is exactly the parity-dependent spectrum stated in source Conjecture 29, with maximum absolute Walsh coefficient $2^{2m}(2^m+1)$ and hence $$\operatorname{NL}(F)=2^{5m-1}-2^{2m-1}(2^m+1).$$ Prove the complete conjectured spectra for both parities of $m$, or give a counterexample.

scope.domain: Walsh spectra of Dobbertin APN power functions over binary finite fields
assumptions: The spectrum is the source-defined extended Walsh spectrum
scope.unresolved_remainder: The complete parity-dependent Walsh spectra and maximum-coefficient formula in Conjecture 29 remain unproved for arbitrary positive integer m.

progress.summary: Conjecture 29 gives exact parity-dependent spectra and the resulting nonlinearity formula for the Dobbertin family.
